q: (Only Allaah knows the meaning of these letters).
These are the verses of the Book and the clear Qur'aan
(whose principles are clear, whose laws are explained and whose narrations are truthful).
v.s: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
v.c: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran.

q: (on the Day of Qiyaamah when they will see the success of the Muslims,)
the Kuffaar will wish that they were Muslims.
v.s: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
v.c: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺.

q: (Since the Kuffaar refuse to listen to the message of Islaam,)
Leave them to eat, to enjoy and let their hopes
Soon they will come to know
v.s: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
v.c: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know.

v.s: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
v.c: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term.

q: No nation can hasten their term
(bring the date of their destruction forward),
(The time of their period of prosperity and their downfall, like our birth and death, has already been decided)
v.s: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
v.c: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it.

q: said, “O you upon whom the Qur'aan has been revealed
v.s: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
v.c: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane!

q: “Why do you not come with angels
(to verify that you are a Rasool)
(in your claim that you are a Rasool and that the Qur'aan is from Allaah)?”
v.s: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
v.c: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”

q: (Allaah warns the Kuffaar not to ask for angels to come to earth because)
We send the angels only with the decision
v.s: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
v.c: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed.

q: Without doubt only We have revealed the Reminder
We shall certainly be its protectors
(ensuring that it remains unchanged throughout time).
v.s: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
v.c: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it.

q: (Consoling Rasulullaah ﷺ not to worry about the mockery of the Kuffaar, Allaah says,)
Undoubtedly We have sent Rusul before you to the previous groups
v.s: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
v.c: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples,

q: every one of the Rusul that came to them.
v.s: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
v.c: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked.

q: (as We had caused the mocking of the past nations to enter their hearts, so too)
(the mocking of the Kuffaar of Makkah)
enter into the hearts of the sinners
(as a result of which, their hearts cannot accept the light of Imaan).
v.s: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
v.c: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked.

q: They do not believe in it
of the previous people have passed
(even though they know that the previous nations were destroyed for rejecting the revelation that their Ambiyaa ﵊ brought to them).
v.s: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
v.c: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before.

q: (In fact, the Kuffaar are so stubborn that even)
If We open to them a door of the sky and they
v.s: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
v.c: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend,

q: say, “Our eyes have merely been mesmerised
(This is exactly what they would say about any other miracle that a Nabi shows them. It is for this reason that Allaah did not show the Kuffaar the miracles they had asked of the Ambiyaa ﵊.)
v.s: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
v.c: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”

q: Verily We have placed stars in the sky and decorated it for spectators.
v.s: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
v.c: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see.

v.s: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of God]
v.c: And We protected it from every accursed devil,

q: (The sky is protected from every Shaytaan)
Except the one who steals a hearing
(manages to overhear something from the angels).

(which either kills him or drives him insane). (When the Shayaateen try to listen to the angels discussing future events, the angels throw stars at them. However, some manage to pass on to other Shayaateen what they have heard before the star strikes them. The Shayaateen then pass this information on to human fortune-tellers mixed with hundreds of lies. When people discover that some of the predictions of these fortune-tellers come true, they become devoted to them, forgetting the hundreds of untruths that they had also predicted.)
v.s: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
v.c: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare.

q: We have spread out the earth, placed mountains on it
v.s: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
v.c: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance.

q: of life on earth for you
and We have created those things
for which you do not provide.
v.s: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
v.c: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for.

q: We have with Us the treasures of all things
(rain, mineral wealth, food, spiritual guidance, etc)
and We send them down only in stipulated quantities
(as the need arises, according to Allaah's wisdom).
v.s: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
v.c: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure.

m: and We gave it to you to drink
q: We send the winds that fill the clouds with water, then send water from the sky which We give you to drink. You do not have the ability to store it

(man cannot store rain water in as large a quantity as Allaah does when He stores water in lakes, dams, rivers and in underground reservoirs of groundwater where massive quantities of water are stored for people to use whenever they need to).
v.s: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
v.c: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves.

q: Without doubt, it is We Who give life and
death, and We will be the successors
(only Allaah will be Alive after everything is destroyed on the Day of Qiyaamah what the records of man remain with Allaah)
v.s: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
v.c: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor.

q: Indeed, We know those of you who are first
(those who inhabited the earth during the early days, the early Muslims and also those who stand in the front rows during congregational salaah in the Masjid)
and those of you who follow after
(those who have lived afterwards, the later Muslims and those who occupy the back rows in the Masjid).
v.s: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
v.c: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺.

q: Certainly your Rabb Alone shall gather
Verily He is The Wise, The All Knowing.
v.s: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
v.c: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing.

q: out of, melodious sand extracted from moistened clay.

(The various verses of the Qur'aan individually refer to various stages in man's creation. The fact is that water was mixed with soil, turning it into clay. Then this clay was left until it began to decompose and become dark in colour. Thereafter the mould of Aadam ﵊ was cast with this. When the clay dried and set, it became like potted clay that has a melodious sound when struck.)
v.s: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
v.c: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud.

v.s: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
v.c: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire.

q: When your Rabb said to the angels
out of melodious sand extracted from moistened clay.”
v.s: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, “I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
v.c: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud.

q: him and blown into him a spirit from Me
(as a symbol your obedience to me).
v.s: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
v.c: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”

q: Every one of the angels prostrated
v.s: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
v.c: So the angels prostrated all together—

q: ...except Iblees. He refused to be among those who prostrated.
v.s: Except Iblees; he refused to be with those who prostrated.
v.c: but not Iblîs, who refused to prostrate with the others.

q: Allaah said, “O Iblees! What is the matter with you that you are not among those
v.s: [God] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
v.c: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”

q: He replied, “I am not one to prostrate before a human that You created out of melodious sand extracted from moistened clay.”
v.s: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
v.c: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”

q: for you are indeed an outcast.”
v.s: [God] said, “Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.
v.c: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed.

q: “You shall be accursed until the day of Qiyaamah.”
v.s: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
v.c: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

v.s: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
v.c: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”

q: Allaah said, “You are of those granted respite...
v.s: [God] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
v.c: Allah said, “You will be delayed

q: (when the trumpet will be blown to sound the arrival of Qiyaamah).”
v.s: Until the Day of the time well-known."
v.c: until the appointed Day.”

q: said, “My Rabb! Because You have sent me astray, I will certainly beautify things
(have them with the attribution of evil)
on earth and lead them all astray
(using all the devious means at my disposal).”
v.s: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
v.c: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together,

q: Except those bondsmen of Yours who are chosen
(whom You have chosen to save from my guile and treachery).”
v.s: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
v.c: except Your chosen servants among them.”

q: (being chosen because of doing good and refraining from evil)
straight path that leads to Me.”
v.s: [God] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
v.c: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me:

q: (that your control will be limited to)
those deviant ones who follow you
v.s: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
v.c: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you,

m: (is) surely the promised place for them
v.s: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
v.c: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together.

q: has seven doors. Each door shall have a stipulated share of them.”
v.s: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."
v.c: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”

v.s: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,
v.c: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs.

q: (Angels will welcome them to Jannah saying,)
(Here you will have no worries, fears, hardship, injuries or losses).”
v.s: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
v.c: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”

q: that may be in their breasts. As brothers
(with love and affection for each other)
will be seated on couches, facing each other
v.s: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
v.c: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another.

q: neither will they be removed from there
v.s: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
v.c: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave.

q: Inform My bondsmen that I am certainly the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful
(I shall forgive all sins when My bondsman repents sincerely)...
v.s: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
v.c: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful,

q: (they should not let Shaytaan deceive them into thinking that they can continue sinning and repent later because)
My punishment is definitely a most painful punishment
(and they should never risk suffering My punishment).
v.s: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
v.c: and that My torment is indeed the most painful.

q: (the angels who visited Ibraheem ﵊ in human form to inform him about the birth of his son Is'haaq ﵊ and to warn him that they were going to destroy the people of Loot ﵊).
v.s: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
v.c: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests

q: When they entered his presence, they greeted with Salaam.
(However, when Ibraheem ﵊ served them some food, they did not eat. Sensing that they had come to punish someone,)
v.s: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."
v.c: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”

q: They said, “Do not be afraid. Indeed, we wish to convey to you the good news of
(by the name of Is'haaq ﵊, who will be born to your wife).'
v.s: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
v.c: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”

m: Do you give me glad tidings
Do you give me glad tidings
q: said, “Do you give me this good news when old-age has afflicted me
(How can I father a child when I am such an old man)?
What then is this very good news that you are delivering
(please repeat what you said because it seems too astonishing)?”
v.s: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
v.c: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”

q: They said, “We convey to you the
good news of a reality, so do not become of the despondent ones
(Never lose hope in Allaah's power because nothing is impossible for Allaah).”
v.s: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
v.c: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”

v.s: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
v.c: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”

q: “What business do you have, O messengers
(Why have you been sent to earth)?”
v.s: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
v.c: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O messenger-angels?”

q: They said, “We have been sent to
v.s: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
v.c: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people.

q: We shall surely rescue all of them
v.s: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
v.c: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all,

q: (to be destroyed along with the sinners).”
v.s: Except his wife." We [i.e., God] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
v.c: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”

q: (After leaving Ibraheem ﵊, the angels proceeded to inform Loot ﵊ about their duty.)
When the messengers came to the family of Loot...
v.s: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
v.c: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

v.s: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
v.c: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”

q: (that it would ever come to them).”
v.s: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
v.c: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted.

m: And we have come to you
q: We have brought the truth to you and we are certainly from the truthful ones
(you should therefore do exactly as we say).'
v.s: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
v.c: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.

q: with your family during a portion
of the night, follow on their heels
(to ensure that all of them are with you)
and let none of you turn around
(to look at what is to become of the others).
Then proceed to where you have been commanded
v.s: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
v.c: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”

q: We informed him of Our decision that the roots of these people shall be severed by the morning
(they will all be destroyed without trace by the morning).
v.s: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
v.c: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”

q: (As the angels were talking to Loot ﵊)
The people of the town came rejoicing
(they rushed happily to where Loot ﵊ stood with the angels because they intended to commit sodomy with the angels whom they mis-took to be merely handsome men).
v.s: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
v.c: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing.
v.h: Destruction of the People of Lot

q: are my guests, so do not disgrace me
(in front of them by making your intentions known to them)...
v.s: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
v.c: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me.

q: Allaah and do not humiliate me.'
v.s: And fear God and do not disgrace me."
v.c: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”

q: replied, “Have we not forbidden you from
(had you done what we told you, you would not be faced with this situation of being humiliated)?”
v.s: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
v.c: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”

v.s: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
v.c: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”

q: (their intense desires made them oblivious of all good advice). (Nevertheless, they were unable to harm the angels at all.)
v.s: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
v.c: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺.

q: (Allaah's punishment finally came to them when)
a scream seized them at sunrise
(Jibra'eel ﵊ gave a piercing scream that caused them to die with fear).
v.s: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
v.c: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise.

q: (Jibra'eel ﵊ lifted their towns into the sky and then dropped them upside down)
and showered clay pebbles on them
(each pebble was marked with the name of the person it was meant to strike).
v.s: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
v.c: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay.

q: Indeed in this are Aayaat for those who have
(by this they can understand the severe consequences of disobeying the Ambiyaa ﵊).
v.s: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
v.c: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate.

q: These towns are along an accessible thoroughfare
(the ruins of these towns fell on the road that the people of Makkah used when travelling to Shaam, making it easy for them to learn a lesson and thus believe in Rasulullaah)
v.s: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
v.c: Their ruins still lie along a known route.

q: There is certainly a sign in this for the Mu'mineen.
v.s: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
v.c: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe.

q: Without doubt, the people of Aykah
(because they rejected the message of Shu'ayb ﵊, cheated people in business, robbed people and committed Shirk).
v.s: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
v.c: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers,

q: So We extracted vengeance from them
(the ruins of the cities of the people of Loot ﵊ and the city of the people of Shu'ayb ﵊ people)
(a well travelled road that the people of Makkah used en route to Shaam).
v.s: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
v.c: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road. The People of Ṣâliḥ

q: (although Saalih ﵊ was the only Nabi who came to the Thamud, the verse mentions that they rejected all the Ambiyaa ﵊. This is so because rejecting the message of one Nabi is tantamount to rejecting all the Ambiyaa ﵊ since all their messages were the same).
v.s: And certainly did the companions of alHijr [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
v.c: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers.

q: (such as the camel emerging from a mountain)
came to them, yet they ignored these
v.s: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
v.c: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them.

q: They used to carve homes out of the mountains with peace
v.s: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
v.c: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure.

q: (However, despite their ingenuity and strength, Allaah's punishment destroyed them when)
A scream seized them during the morning
(this scream of Jibra'eel ﵊ was so terrifying that it killed them).
v.s: But the shriek seized them at early morning,
v.c: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning,

q: Whatever they earned was of no benefit to them
(because it neither saved them from Allaah's punishment in this world nor will it save them in the Aakhirah).
v.s: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
v.c: and all they achieved was of no help to them.

q: We have created the heavens, the earth and whatever is between them with the truth
(when people will be punished for their wrongs),
v.s: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
v.c: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously.

v.s: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
v.c: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing.

q: seven verses that are often repeated
(Surah Faatiha, which people recite very often, especially in salaah),

(These are bounties that are eternal, which are of immense benefit to a person in his world and will earn him/her magnificent rewards in the Aakhirah. The harassment of the Kuffaar should therefore not be a source of grief.)
v.s: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.
v.c: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran.

q: (Since you have these tremendous bounties, you should)
Never focus your eyes on the enjoyment that We have granted to the various groups of the Kuffaar, do not grieve over them
(over the fact that they do not accept Imaan. If they refuse to accept after you have made an effort to give them the message, do not bother with them),
(focussing your attention on those who have accepted, you should)
lower your wings for the Mu'mineen
(be gentle and Forgiving towards them when making an effort to make them successful Muslims).
v.s: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
v.c: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers.

q: “Indeed I am but a clear warner
(All I can do is warn you about the punishment you will suffer for rejecting Imaan. I have no power to make you accept).'
v.s: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
v.c: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—

q: (Beware that We do not send Our punishment to you)
As We had sent to the dividers...
v.s: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
v.c: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺,

q: (by accepting certain portions and rejecting others in a mocking manner).
v.s: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.
v.c: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others.

q: By your Rabb! We will definitely question each one of them
v.s: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
v.c: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all

v.s: About what they used to do.
v.c: about what they used to do.

q: you have been commanded with and ignore the Mushrikeen
(do not worry about their disbelievers because it will not be able to stop Islaam).
v.s: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
v.c: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.

q: We are enough for you against those who ridicule...
v.s: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
v.c: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers,

q: ...And those who ascribe another Ilaah to Allaah. Soon they will come to know
(the error of their ways when Allaah's punishment strikes them)!
v.s: Who make [equal] with God another deity. But they are going to know.
v.c: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know.

q: We know very well that your bosom
v.s: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
v.c: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say.

q: (to combat the effects of this distress and hurt, you should)
glorify the praises of your Rabb, be among those who prostrate
v.s: So exalt [God] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
v.c: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray,

q: ...and worship your Rabb until the certainty
(When a person dedicates himself to Allaah's worship and is concerned about the Aakhirah, he will not be greatly distressed by the troubles and worries of this world.)
v.s: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
v.c: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way.
